diagnostic.iter4_root_cause: Trajectory 10 m/s vs cmd 5 m/s mismatch → lateral lag → miss gates 2/3
diagnostic.iter5_root_cause: 5 m/s at gate-6→gate-7 caused helix-entry tumble
diagnostic.iter6_root_cause: Sequential plane-crossing sequencer missed helix gates where trajectory skimmed within 1-1.8m of center but outside the 0.6m lateral plane-crossing window. Enabled proximity_pass_distance=1.2 as a safety net.
diagnostic.iter7_root_cause: Helix interior gates (7/8/9/10/11) had only iter44-era 5% time inflation, which combined with 4m/s cmd cap left controller too little headroom to track the polynomial's lateral acceleration demand. Reverting partway to pre-iter44 (5%→6%) gave helix segments 1% more time, cutting avg_tracking_error 35%. Full revert (10%) would be even better for tracking but re-introduces gate-7 tumble dynamics.
diagnostic.iter7_offangle_gate_analysis: Gate-10 has yaw=-120°, normal radially-outward from helix center. Racing tangent between g9 and g11 is 82° off the gate normal (computed via central-diff waypoints). The other 5 helix gates are similarly 52-93° off. The drone cannot traverse them front-to-back aligned with the gate normal; it necessarily skims tangentially and relies on proximity detection (1.2m) to register pass. Tightening trajectory geometry via normal-aligned entry/exit offsets (codex P0) would require aggressive radial detours per gate that the controller cannot follow.
